Air New Zealand: international connections and lounge eligibility at Auckland

recommendation.summary: Food and showers when allocated the main lounge; check-in may direct you to an alternative during rebuilding.

lounges.note: Staged refurbishment continues through the end of 2027. Eligible guests may be allocated the temporary Lookout Lounge, which has different facilities and opening hours. This is not a guarantee of access to the main lounge.

qualityRating.summary: The 2022 visit praised the spacious design, varied seating and food. This historical assessment predates the current rebuild and does not describe the temporary Lookout Lounge or the future refurbished lounge.

sources.title: Point Hacks · Air New Zealand Auckland International Lounge review

lounges.name: Strata Lounge
lounges.location: After security, Level 2; turn left at the top of the escalators and follow Premium Lounges signs.

sources.title: Auckland Airport: Strata Lounge facilities and program entry

recommendation.summary: An independent alternative with a hot and cold buffet and complimentary showers.

lounges.note: Priority Pass visits are limited to three hours; direct paid bookings have separate terms. Allow time to walk to your gate.

qualityRating.summary: An October 2025 visit found comfortable seating, a broad breakfast spread and accessible showers. The reviewer found it calm at that visit, but food and exclusivity were less premium than airline lounges.

sources.title: Sarah Symbalisty · Strata Lounge firsthand review
